course.title: Unit 6 Changing for the seasons--Lesson B-【例句】
course.description: Unit 6 Changing for the seasons--Lesson B-【例句】

sentences.content: Sarah, which season do you like?
sentences.english: Sarah , which season do you like ?

sentences.content: Winter. It snows a lot. I can play in the snow and make a snowman.
sentences.english: Winter . It snows a lot . I can play in the snow and make a snowman
sentences.chinese: 冬天。雪下得很大。我可以在雪地里玩耍，堆个雪人。

wordDetails.definition: snow（第三人称单数）: 下雪

sentences.content: I like winter too. There are many festivals. My family and I often get together and have fun.
sentences.english: I like winter too . There are many festivals . My family and I often get together and have fun
sentences.chinese: 我也喜欢冬天。有很多节日，我和家人经常聚在一起玩乐。

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 聚在一起
短语动词原型: 玩得开心

sentences.content: Winter. I can make a snowman.
sentences.english: Winter . I can make a snowman

sentences.content: Thirty students like spring. Fifteen students like...
sentences.english: Thirty students like spring . Fifteen students like ...
sentences.chinese: 三十名学生喜欢春天。十五名学生喜欢...

sentences.content: Spring is green. It's full of life. I take many walks, And fly my kite.
sentences.english: Spring is green . It's full of life . I take many walks , And fly my kite
sentences.chinese: 春天是绿色的，生机盎然。我常去散步，还放风筝。

sentences.content: Autumn is orange. I like the falling leaves. I wear sweaters and shirts, And enjoy mooncakes.
sentences.english: Autumn is orange . I like the falling leaves . I wear sweaters and shirts , And enjoy mooncakes
sentences.chinese: 秋天是橙色的。我喜欢飘落的树叶。我穿着毛衣和衬衫，品尝着月饼。

sentences.content: Summer is blue. I play games and sing songs, Wear dresses and T-shirts. The days are so long.
sentences.english: Summer is blue . I play games and sing songs , Wear dresses and T-shirts . The days are so long
sentences.chinese: 夏天是蓝色的。我玩游戏、唱歌谣，穿连衣裙和T恤衫。白昼如此悠长。

sentences.content: Winter is white. I make snowmen with friends, Wear warm coats and gloves. Then spring comes again.
sentences.english: Winter is white . I make snowmen with friends , Wear warm coats and gloves . Then spring comes again
sentences.chinese: 冬日银装素裹。我与朋友们堆雪人，穿着温暖的棉袄和手套。而后春天再度降临。
